home.title: Authorized number and messaging workspace
home.description: NumDock brings identity, authorized number provisioning, and tenant-scoped messaging into one workspace.
home.heroTitle: Numbers and messages, under your organization's control.
home.heroDescription: Manage organization access, number leases, messages, billing and developer integrations. Check the current feature modes below; Mock actions are development samples and do not use live carriers or payments.
home.capabilitiesTitle: Built as a workspace, not a shared inbox.
home.capabilitiesDescription: The console is organized around your organization, its access boundaries, and the resources it is allowed to use.
home.capabilityAccessDescription: Every workspace action is tied to your account and organization membership.
home.capabilityProviderDescription: Live inventory requires an authorized provider. Development inventory is explicitly labeled Mock and is isolated from real carrier resources.
home.capabilityMessagingDescription: Messages are read through a lease and never pooled into a public code feed.
home.securityDescription: Sessions, organization access, message encryption and immutable billing records are enforced by the backend. Development transactions and messages remain clearly labeled Mock.
home.securitySessionDescription: Only a token hash is stored; the raw session token stays in an HttpOnly cookie.
home.securityNoSharedDescription: Verification messages are never exposed across customers or through a public feed.
home.securityAuditDescription: Hiding a button is not authorization. Access is checked by the API.
home.ctaTitle: Manage your organization in one workspace.
home.ctaDescription: Open the workspace for your organization. Check feature status before using number, messaging, billing or developer operations.
auth.draftNotice: Visible fields are saved in this browser; your password is not.
notFound.description: The page you are looking for moved, vanished, or never existed.
home.publicAccessDescription: Browse the platform, check live service status, and read the API reference before creating an account.
home.publicApiDescription: Read the OpenAPI contract, request examples, and error responses before you integrate.
home.signInForDescription: An organization account is required for actions that touch inventory, messages, or money. Browsing and status pages stay public.
home.signInForBuy: Manage number orders and exclusive leases in the enabled environment
home.signInForMessages: Read messages tied to your organization's leases
home.signInForBilling: Manage billing and the organization ledger
platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Current backend capabilities, organization account requirements, and the connection state of live providers and payment channels.

platform.publicDescription: Public pages never expose customer data, message content, or private inventory.
platform.authDescription: Sign-in is reserved for actions with business side effects or tenant data.
security.title: Security
security.description: How NumDock handles sessions, access boundaries, and message data as the platform grows.
security.accessDescription: Every workspace read and mutation is authorized server-side against the user and organization. The frontend never decides access by hiding a button.
security.dataDescription: Messages are read through a lease and are never pooled into a public code feed. Verification content must not appear in logs, traces, or error monitoring.
security.ctaDescription: Platform status and API documentation are public. Create a workspace only when you need organization-scoped actions.
